summary: West Royalty is Charlottetown's car-and-big-box edge: University Avenue's pads and plazas, the SmartCentres boxes (BuyMart, The House Depot, Chasm) on Buchanan Drive, and Capital Drive's run of 2000s-2010s hotels, car lots and drive-throughs out to the Maypoint roundabout and the COWS barn at the North River causeway. Behind it sit provincial institutions (Royalty Centre, Beach Grove and Prince Edward Homes, offices on Beach Grove Road), two steel-shed industrial parks and the BioCommons, and housing that runs from 1960s-70s bungalows on North River Road and Lewis Point to new four- and six-storey apartment blocks. Big recent changes: the RCMP left Maypoint Road for Cornwall (2025), Calvary Church is being repaired after Fiona instead of becoming two towers (2025), and new apartments keep arriving on Malpeque Road and off Lower Malpeque Road.

buildings.name: Walmart Supercentre, 80 Buchanan Drive (SmartCentres Charlottetown) -> BuyMart
buildings.facts: The anchor of the SmartCentres power centre (listed at 80 Buchanan Drive). CBC photo from an evacuation in July 2016 (bomb threat; reopened the same day). A 2021 robbery and assault in its lot made the news. Closed on Christmas, Boxing Day, Labour Day and Thanksgiving; 7 a.m. to 10 p.m. on Canada Day 2026. The front looks north-northwest onto Buchanan Drive and its lot.

A dark grey shingled mansard-style accent (#4b4f57) on the far right corner block. Flat roof, about 8-9 m walls, the vestibule and sign panel about 11-12 m. A second entrance (grocery side) usually mirrors it at the other end. Canadian flag on a pole at the far left.

Its entrance road was named 'Milky Way' by council in October 2016 after the Maypoint/causeway roundabout went in (a summer student's idea). Wowie, the fibreglass cow from the airport's arrivals hall, was sent back to the creamery store in March 2023 when the airport renovated. CEO said in 2023 that staff got ~10% raises.

current_events.what: Queens District RCMP left the Maypoint Road detachment (closed to the public May 5, 2025) for a new building in Cornwall that opened in August 2025, a year late, at about $25M against an $18.5M estimate (land bought from the town for $725K). Their own chief superintendent called Maypoint 'not a functional detachment': no cells, cramped. The empty building went on the commercial market.

Calvary Church (Capital Drive) was wrecked by Fiona in Sept 2022; a Toronto developer's plan for two high-rises of about 400 apartments plus a clinic was dropped in Sept 2025 ('the idea that a Toronto developer would come in and do it all and then hand over the keys') and the congregation is repairing with a $3.2M insurance settlement; still closed three years on.

The city's West Royalty transportation plan (2021) widens Capital Drive to four, five and six lanes by 2031 and adds new streets by 2041 'when developers start developing their lands'; residents said the plan's maps 'offer nothing to the citizens' and that apartments are going up too fast. The 2026-27 budget finally funds the Capital Drive / North River Road intersection (roadwork under way 2026) and the Spencer Drive extension.
current_events.where: Capital Drive at North River Road

current_events.what: North River Road master plan (Oct 2023): an extra left-turn lane onto Capital Drive, a roundabout at Beach Grove Road, lights at Kirkwood Drive, bike lanes; waiting on the University Avenue redesign, which has slipped from 2024 to 2027. A resident said turning left onto North River Road is 'near a suicide attempt'.

Beach Grove Road culvert (a 1940s-50s wooden culvert an engineer said to replace 'immediately') was rebuilt in fall 2022 for $4M, cutting off ~900 Lewis Point households for 12 weeks, starting the week school went back; the city's advice: 'turn up the tunes'.

Capital Drive's twin stormwater culverts were replaced in Nov 2020 ($1.3M), closing the road between Action Car and Truck Accessories and the Holiday Inn Express with hour-long backups and drivers taking the wrong detour.

Garden Home (private long-term care) has run on a provisional licence since January 2022 for not meeting inspection standards; in 2026 the province gave the same operator the contract for 82 new beds at Whisperwood (over $100M over 30 years, beds by 2029).
Island Gymnastics Academy at the Royalty Centre is 'completely full': 1,500 gymnasts, 200 on a wait list, five years looking for a building, hoping for a spot in Stratford's future campus (2023).
